scenario.title: 租車、自駕、做白日夢
scenario.context: 自駕旅行時常會聊「如果我有錢，我就買台露營車」「如果我是你，我會買全險」。這種「不太可能」或「跟現實相反」的假設，用的是第二類條件句：If + 過去式, would + 原形。

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.en: Would you like to add full insurance? It's an extra 15 dollars a day.
lines.zh: 要加保全險嗎？一天多 15 塊。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Hmm, what do you think, Jess?

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: If I were you, I'd get it. You're not used to driving on the right.
lines.zh: 如果我是你，我會加。你不習慣靠右開。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Good point. If I scratched the car, I'd feel terrible. OK, full insurance, please.
lines.zh: 說得對。如果我刮到車，我會很難過。好，全險，謝謝。

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.en: Smart choice. Even a small fender bender can get expensive.
lines.zh: 聰明的選擇。就算是小擦撞也可能很貴。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Is this car a gas guzzler? We're driving a lot.
lines.zh: 這台車很耗油嗎？我們會開很多路。

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.en: It's a hybrid, so it's pretty efficient.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: Fine. Ugh, look at this traffic. It's bumper-to-bumper.
lines.zh: 好啦。唉，看這車潮，整條都塞住了。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: If we had left an hour earlier, we wouldn't be stuck… never mind.
lines.zh: 如果我們早一小時出發就不會卡住……算了。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: If you could live anywhere in the world, where would you live?
lines.zh: 如果你可以住在世界上任何地方，你會住哪？

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: Somewhere with no traffic. If I had the money, I'd buy a house in the mountains.
lines.zh: 沒有塞車的地方。如果我有錢，我會在山上買間房子。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: If I lived in the mountains, I'd never get any work done. I'd just stare at the view.
lines.zh: 如果我住在山上，我永遠不會做事，只會一直看風景。

Do I need to return it with a full tank?

patterns.note: 閒聊時的經典假設問題

chinglish.wrong: If I am you, I will buy insurance.
chinglish.right: If I were you, I'd get insurance.
chinglish.why: 「如果我是你」是不可能的假設，要用 were + would。中文的「如果」不區分可能與不可能。

chinglish.wrong: If I have money, I would buy a house.
chinglish.right: If I had the money, I'd buy a house.
chinglish.why: 第二類條件句 if 子句用過去式，主要子句用 would。兩邊時態要一致。
口語中 If I was you 也常聽到，但 If I were you 是標準固定說法，考試和寫作要用 were。

chinglish.right: The traffic is terrible. / We're stuck in traffic.
chinglish.why: jam 是名詞，說 a traffic jam；「塞車」口語多說 traffic is bad / we're stuck in traffic。

grammar.title: 條件句 type 2：If I were…
grammar.oneLiner: If + 過去式, would + 原形：講現在或未來「不太可能」或「跟現實相反」的假設。
whenToUse: 跟現實相反：If I had a car, I'd drive.（但我沒有車）
不太可能發生：If I won the lottery, I'd quit my job.
be 動詞一律用 were（尤其 If I were you）。
主要子句可以用 would / could / might + 原形。
給建議：If I were you, I'd…
比較 type 1：If it rains, we'll stay in.（真的可能）vs If it snowed in Taipei, I'd be shocked.（幾乎不可能）
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文的「如果」不管可能或不可能，動詞都不變：「如果下雨」「如果我是你」「如果我中樂透」。英文則用「往過去退一格」表示距離現實很遠，這對台灣人來說很反直覺：明明講的是現在，為什麼要用過去式？把過去式想成「心理上的距離」就比較好理解。

examples.correct: If I were you, I'd take the train.
examples.incorrect: If I am you, I will take the train.
examples.note: 不可能的假設用 were / would。

examples.correct: If I had more time, I'd learn to drive.
What would you do if you lost your passport?
If we lived closer, we could hang out more.
examples.note: 主要子句也可以用 could。

examples.correct: I wouldn't drive here if I were you. The roads are crazy.

quiz.question: If I ___ you, I'd get full insurance.
If I had a car, I ___ drive to work.
If I ___ (win) the lottery, I'd travel around the world.
Which one is a real possibility (type 1)?
options: If it rains tomorrow, we'll stay in.
If I were a bird, I'd fly home.
If I had wings, I'd fly.
quiz.explanation: 明天下雨是真的有可能，用 type 1。

quiz.question: What ___ you do if you got lost in a foreign city?

slang.usage: fender 是擋泥板，指沒人受傷的輕微車禍。

examples.en: Sorry I'm late. There was a fender bender on the highway.
examples.zh: 抱歉遲到，高速公路上有小擦撞。

examples.en: It was just a fender bender. Nobody got hurt.

slang.usage: 大喊 Shotgun! 就是宣告要坐副駕。有不成文的規則：要看到車才能喊。

examples.en: Shotgun! I get the front seat.
You can't call shotgun from inside the house!
examples.zh: 你不能在屋子裡就喊副駕啦！

slang.usage: guzzle = 狂喝。形容油耗很高的車。

examples.en: My dad's old SUV is a real gas guzzler.
examples.zh: 我爸那台舊休旅車超耗油。

examples.en: I sold my gas guzzler and bought an electric scooter.
examples.zh: 我把耗油的車賣了，買了電動機車。

slang.meaning: 車子一台接一台、大塞車
slang.usage: bumper-to-bumper traffic = 車距很近、幾乎不動的車潮。

examples.en: It was bumper-to-bumper all the way to Yilan.
I hate driving at rush hour. It's always bumper-to-bumper.
examples.zh: 我討厭尖峰時間開車，永遠在塞。

review.question: I suggest ___ early to avoid the traffic.
The GPS doesn't ___ to be working.
review.explanation: 複習第 43 單元：doesn't seem to。

review.question: Which is correct?
options: We got the car off at the gas station.
We got out of the car at the gas station.
review.explanation: 複習第 41 單元：下汽車用 get out of（公車火車用 get off）。

review.question: It was ___ long drive!
review.explanation: 複習第 37 單元：such a + 形容詞 + 名詞。

review.question: You've driven on the right before, ___?
review.explanation: 複習第 29 單元：You've → haven't you。

review.question: Driving in the city is so ___ (stress). I prefer the MRT.
review.explanation: 複習第 13 單元形容詞：stressful（令人有壓力的）。

review.question: Which is correct?
options: If I am you, I will rent a smaller car.
If I were you, I'd rent a smaller car.
If I was you, I will rent a smaller car.
